# VSQ lip sync (LoadVsqFile): menu 224, a dropped .vsq, and a drop in camera
# mode, which the handler refuses with a message box.
load model lips.pmd
load lip sync basic.vsq
save pmm menu.pmm
select all morph
save vmd menu.vmd

frame 0
drop vowels.vsq
save pmm drop.pmm

select camera
drop rests.vsq
save pmm refused.pmm
